replay.simulation_note: Capital path is an exposure replay approximation using daily QQQ adjusted-close returns multiplied by prior-session target leverage. It is not TQQQ/QLD execution parity and excludes financing, slippage, fees and leveraged-ETF path effects.

regime_analytics.note: Durations are calendar-day intervals between verified transition dates; not reconstructed trading-session rows.

lean_daily_manifest.scope: Fingerprint of 3,774 real LEAN daily SL724 states. Does not prove Python feature/input parity.
